description: Neo4j bidirectional converter — lossless round-trip between the canonical TSV schema and a Neo4j property graph: bulk seed via neo4j-admin import, incremental updates via LOAD CSV, export back to TSV via APOC, with a round-trip test proving TSV -> Neo4j -> TSV is byte-stable, plus schema constraints and example Cypher.

tasks.title: T4-US-001: Add the Neo4j converter module and optional dependency
tasks.description:
As a developer, I need the neo4j driver wired in optionally so the converter is isolated from core.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Add an optional 'neo4j' extra in pyproject.toml pulling the official neo4j Python driver
- Create src/culturescrape/neo4j/__init__.py with a connection helper reading URI/user/password from env or config
- Connection helper fails with a clear message when the driver extra is not installed
- Tests pass (pytest) for config parsing with the driver mocked
- Type checks pass (mypy)

tasks.title: T4-US-002: Generate neo4j-admin import header/argument mapping from canonical TSV
tasks.description:
As a user, I want the bulk-import command derived from my TSV so seeding a fresh DB is one step.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Given a directory of nodes/*.tsv and edges/*.tsv, generate the neo4j-admin import invocation with correct --nodes/--relationships args and --delimiter set to tab
- Verify our headers (csid:ID, :LABEL, :START_ID, :END_ID, :TYPE, typed properties) are already valid neo4j-admin headers; if any transformation is needed, write transformed copies rather than mutating originals
- Emit the command to a script file and print it; do not require a live DB to generate it
- Tests pass (pytest) asserting the generated command references every node and edge file with correct flags
- Type checks pass (mypy)

tasks.title: T4-US-003: Implement LOAD CSV incremental import
tasks.description:
As a user, I want to add/update data into an existing graph so the DB stays current without a rebuild.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Generate parameterized Cypher using LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS and FIELDTERMINATOR '\t' that MERGEs nodes on csid and MERGEs relationships on (:START_ID,:END_ID,:TYPE)
- MERGE semantics ensure re-running the same import does not duplicate nodes or edges (idempotent)
- Typed property columns are coerced to int/float/string per the header suffix
- Tests pass (pytest) generating the Cypher and asserting MERGE (not CREATE) is used for both nodes and edges
- Type checks pass (mypy)

tasks.title: T4-US-006: Prove the round-trip is lossless
tasks.description:

- The test covers nodes with multiple labels, multi-value fields, and BCE dates
